specialists.name: ads-manager
specialists.description: Audits ad-account structure and tracking (CAPI/EMQ, Consent Mode), and proposes a budget-reallocation plan with expected effects. Use for ad audit, campaign structure, budget plan, or ROAS.

specialists.name: code-reviewer
specialists.description: Reviews code or a diff for correctness, security, and maintainability, returning specific actionable findings. Use for review, code review, or check my changes.

specialists.name: codebase-investigator
specialists.description: Read-only investigation of repository architecture, data flow, dependencies, and runtime behavior. Use for codebase exploration, tracing a feature, and locating implementation evidence.

specialists.name: competitor-watch
specialists.description: Diffs competitor pages or pricing against a stored baseline and returns a change memo. Use for competitor, pricing change, or market watch.

specialists.name: contract-reviewer
specialists.description: Clause-level risk review of a document against the stated playbook, with quoted evidence. Use for contract review, agreement, or terms.

specialists.name: copy-writer
specialists.description: Writes landing-page, email, or ad copy that converts (copywriting gate: specific CTAs, benefits over features, no fabricated stats). Use for copy, landing page words, ad text, or email copy.

specialists.name: data-analyst
specialists.description: Ingests a CSV or dataset, runs typed analysis with verifiable numbers, and returns a findings memo. Use for analyze, dataset, CSV, or statistics.

specialists.name: dependency-auditor
specialists.description: Audits software dependencies and supply-chain surface (SCA, lockfiles, secrets scanning, CI tamper surface). Use for dependency audit, vulnerable packages, or supply chain.

specialists.name: doc-writer
specialists.description: Generates README or API documentation from a codebase, with citations to the files each claim came from. Use for documentation, README, or API docs.

specialists.name: email-lifecycle
specialists.description: Designs deliverability-first email lifecycle flows (welcome, cart, post-purchase, win-back, sunset). Use for email flows, lifecycle, newsletter plan, or deliverability.

specialists.name: incident-responder
specialists.description: Triages an incident: timeline, blast radius, severity, comms draft. Use for incident, outage, or something is on fire.

specialists.name: marketing-strategist
specialists.description: Produces positioning, ICP definition, and a channel plan from a product brief (loops-not-funnels, GEO/AEO aware). Use for positioning, go-to-market, channel plan, or marketing strategy.

specialists.name: mcp-auditor
specialists.description: Audits AI-agent surfaces: MCP servers, agentix solutions, tool definitions, and system prompts (tool poisoning, path traversal, SSRF egress, prompt injection, leakage). Use for MCP audit, agent security, or tool poisoning.

specialists.name: nusabyte-fleet
specialists.description: Routes NusaByte fleet work onto the agentix task bus (nusabyte-hermes): picks the right specialist from the 24-agent registry (codenames), writes TASK-YYYY-MM-DD-NNN briefs into bus queues with approval gates intact. Use for fleet, route this to an agent, nusabyte-hermes, dispatch to finance/hr/ads/admin/bizops, or what agent handles this.

specialists.name: ops-reporter
specialists.description: Builds the weekly operations memo from the agentix run registry: volume, token spend, failures, top solutions. Use for ops report, weekly memo, or agent usage review.

specialists.name: osint-recon
specialists.description: Passive reconnaissance and attack-surface mapping from a domain, company, or name (subdomains, certs, exposures, public footprint). Use for recon, OSINT, attack surface, or footprinting.

specialists.name: release-manager
specialists.description: Builds a changelog, release notes, and a deploy checklist from git history and the working tree. Use for release, changelog, or ship notes.

specialists.name: reverse-engineer
specialists.description: Reverse engineers native, managed, Electron/JavaScript, packaged, firmware, and browser targets with REA (evidence-backed feature teardown, version diffs, decompilation, reconstruction guidance). Use for reverse engineering, decompile, disassemble, understand this app/binary, or how does X work internally.

specialists.name: security-audit
specialists.description: Audits a web app or repo for exploitable vulnerabilities (OWASP Top 10:2025, auth flows, secrets, access control). Use proactively when the user mentions pentest, security review, audit, or is this safe.

specialists.name: seo-auditor
specialists.description: Audits technical SEO and AI-era visibility for a site (crawlability, schema, AI-citation readiness, crawler access policy). Use for SEO audit, rankings, or AI search visibility.

specialists.name: skill-auditor
specialists.description: Read-only pre-install security review of Agent Skills and MCP configurations, including instruction poisoning, dangerous capabilities, remote dependencies, and declaration/implementation mismatch.

specialists.name: support-triage
specialists.description: Classifies and routes a support inbox or ticket dump, drafts replies, and surfaces the top recurring issues. Use for triage, tickets, or support queue.

specialists.name: test-gap-analyst
specialists.description: Read-only analysis of consumer-visible behavior and missing regression coverage. Use for test-gap reviews, boundary analysis, and prioritizing deterministic tests before implementation.

specialists.name: test-writer
specialists.description: Writes or extends test suites for a target module and runs them until green. Use when the user asks for tests, coverage, or regression tests.

specialists.name: ui-critic
specialists.description: Critiques a UI implementation against the anti-slop bar (hierarchy, 8 interaction states, mobile widths, roman headers, restraint). Use for UI review, design critique, or is this UI any good.

specialists.name: unit-economist
specialists.description: Computes unit economics (pricing, margin, CPA, LTV math) from the account's own numbers with shown formulas. Use for unit economics, pricing, margin, or LTV.

specialists.name: uptime-sentinel
specialists.description: Runs scheduled health checks against endpoints, diffs against a stored baseline, and flags regressions. Use for uptime check, health check, or is it down.
